architecture.title: Architecture Overview
architecture.subtitle: Kingdom 7-layer taxonomy: from ingress to guardian, every layer is an independently evolvable defense line

layers.name: Ingress
layers.desc: HTTP / stdio / MCP triple-channel unified entry, OpenAI-compatible protocol passthrough

layers.name: WAF
layers.desc: Path traversal / command injection / SQLi / XSS / prompt injection / PII detection, merged regex + byte prescreen

layers.name: Semantic
layers.desc: Static rules first, gray-zone sent to local small-model adjudication; fail-close — engine unavailable yields 503

layers.name: Governance
layers.desc: Rate limit / IP reputation / RBAC / gatekeeper / audit hash-chain / PII masking, action-level defense

layers.name: Routing
layers.desc: Static rules fallback + ε-greedy bandit auto-optimization; success-rate×latency fused with lm-eval offline scoring

layers.name: Adapter
layers.desc: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Ollama quad-protocol reconstruction, multimodal full-path adaptation

layers.name: Connector
layers.desc: 24 cloud + 8 local runtime registry, shared connection pool 98.5% reuse, circuit-breaker auto-recovery

layers.name: Guardian
layers.desc: L0-L3 tiered response: degrade → fuse → graceful shutdown; RSS-based memory-leak capture, eco resource-saving profile auto-applied

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Installation, upgrade, migration, compatibility, security — your questions answered

items.a: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android on amd64 / arm64; installer auto-detects architecture.

items.q: Do I need a runtime environment?
items.a: No. TSG is a single native binary, no containers, no databases, no runtime dependencies.
Yes. Auto-discovers Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp; token meter compares cloud vs local cost in real time.
No. Default zero-external-traffic profile can shut off all outbound modules; audit and keys stay local.
Delete the install directory (default ~/.tsg/bin or %LOCALAPPDATA%\TarsSecureGuard). No system residue.
Subscription edition supports one-click update package; community edition: download new binary and overwrite, config auto-preserved.
Easy. TSG exposes standard OpenAI-compatible endpoint; point base_url and api_key to TSG, zero client changes.
No. Security Core is mandatory and uncloseable;
one-way merge rule, locked by 100% tests + runtime audit.
Configure OAuth/OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE, supports RS256/ES256 signature verification, role mapping auto-validated into RBAC matrix.
Since v3.2.3 WAF merged regex + byte prescreen solved the main bottleneck (strict -99.8%); pool reuse 98.5%, P99 -27%~-40%.

items.q: How is the API Key managed?
items.a: Default key randomly generated at startup; recommend injecting via TSG_ADMIN_KEY env var; all admin ops are audited.
A router doesn't produce cables or websites — it lets every device access the internet safely. TSG doesn't produce models; it lets every AI client safely use every model.
